## Description

Brief description of the changes introduced by this pull request.

## Type of Change

- [ ] Bug fix (non-breaking change which fixes an issue)
- [ ] New feature (non-breaking change which adds functionality)
- [ ] Breaking change (fix or feature that would cause existing functionality to not work as expected)
- [ ] Documentation update
- [ ] Refactoring / Code style / CI/CD improvements

## Checklist

- [ ] My code follows the code style and formatting conventions of this project (`dotnet format`).
- [ ] I have added tests that prove my fix is effective or that my feature works.
- [ ] All new and existing unit tests pass locally (`dotnet test ./src`).
- [ ] The solution builds without warnings (`dotnet build ./src -warnaserror`).
- [ ] I have updated the documentation / README where appropriate.
